definitions.explanation: The day of the year with the longest period of daylight, occurring around June 21 in the Northern Hemisphere.

examples.japanese: {夏至|げし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{六月|ろくがつ}→六月：00662_rokugatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The summer solstice is in June.

examples.japanese: {夏至|げし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: The summer solstice has the longest daytime of the year.

examples.japanese: {夏至|げし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}く→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧いく。
examples.english: After the summer solstice, the days gradually get shorter.

notes:
The summer solstice, one of the 24 solar terms (⟦{二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}→二十四節気：25146_nijuushisekki⟧) in the traditional East Asian calendar. It falls around June 21 each year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夏至|げし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ — the day of the summer solstice
- {夏至|げし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ — to reach the summer solstice
- {夏至|げし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ — to pass the summer solstice

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{冬至|とうじ}→冬至：11756_touji⟧ — winter solstice (opposite season)
- ⟦{春分|しゅんぶん}→春分：19942_shunbun⟧ — vernal equinox
- ⟦{秋分|しゅうぶん}→秋分：19657_shuubun⟧ — autumnal equinox

CULTURAL NOTE:
Unlike the winter solstice, which has strong food traditions (⟦{冬至|とうじ}→冬至：11756_touji⟧ pumpkin, {柚子湯|ゆずゆ}), the summer solstice has fewer widespread customs in Japan, though some regions celebrate with specific local foods.
